problem: Obligation Terminal Closure waited on a BRAIN pull_request run that cannot exist because Unified Brain Delivery is workflow_dispatch-only; docs-only closures deadlocked despite Required, Skill Projection and CodeQL being green.
root_cause: The terminalizer hard-coded BRAIN as always applicable and filtered Unified Brain Delivery by event=pull_request, which is incompatible with the workflow's actual trigger contract.
fix: Skip BRAIN only for Delivery-Lane docs; for other lanes keep BRAIN mandatory but query exact-head Unified Brain runs independent of event so workflow_dispatch authority is recognized.
prevention: Bind terminal gate applicability to delivery lane.
Never hard-code an event filter that the authoritative workflow cannot emit.
Keep Required and CodeQL exact-head rules unchanged.
